verdict.rationale: The only issue-tracker integration evidenced is a Power-Up to "view work from Jira in a Trello list," which reads as one-way visibility rather than two-way sync and is not tied to a code repository. Beyond that, engineers could build their own sync using the REST API, webhooks and custom Power-Ups, but that is a DIY workaround rather than a shipped capability. Missing for 10: a documented bi-directional sync with a code-repo issue tracker (e.g. GitHub or GitLab issues), evidence that edits propagate both ways, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
